rows.statement: CR-1457 prints no honeycomb half-wavelength, so the cell count of the handbook buckle is still not a number. At the 0.508 mm face the count is 0.13848949362723859 of the R 30 concept shell and 0.1983600586231185 of the R 30 TRL 7 shell, because the 3/8 in cell is not scaled. The classical Hoff-Mautner half-wave at the design point is a different length, 10.252675874314262 cells.

The Hoff-Mautner half-wavelength at the version-10 design point is 0.09765673770284335 m, short beside R 30 m and R 20 m. It does not close the named limit on (2.2-15). The decay depth is 0.957482 of half the core, the core is not the isotropic solid the form assumes, and the classical stress is above both face proxies.

The CR-III tolerance table starts at 0.250 in. The sheet does not say whether a thinner slice is made. No sales office was contacted. Both design cores used here, 12.008 mm and 23.132 mm, sit inside the printed band.
CR-1457 prints γd = 0.20 for hemispheres and 0.35 for ellipsoids and torispherical domes. It prints no cap angle at which the edge stops governing.
No imperfection amplitude over the sandwich thickness is printed for this sandwich. The hemisphere knockdown is empirical. The seeded dimple is reported, not taken from a design value.
No loading rate is printed in CR-1457 or in the 038 plan. None is invented.
The strain uncertainty of 27.813 and 12.980 microstrain, the 0.05 mm displacement uncertainty, and the 0.9525 mm spacing are required gates. No pinned instrument has demonstrated them.

The 038 ranges, 30–90 thousand dollars and 18–45 thousand dollars plus material, price a thin surrogate and a biaxial panel. They do not price these production-sandwich articles. No new price is stated.
345 MPa is a tensile minimum used as compression. 379.2 MPa is a historical sheet compression. Neither is a qualified minimum at 0.508 mm or at 3.668 mm.
Collapse pressures use the model square root of 1−ν². Handbook (4.2-3) uses the one-quarter power. The test reduction has to name the power.
